name: com.uayten.fofuxoanimationtools
description: Editor tools for a pipeline that authors its animations somewhere else and brings them into Unity as standalone .anim assets. Reimport a folder of takes over the clips the project already uses without breaking a reference, be told what breaks before deleting something else depends on, match a new FBX against the materials the project already has, turn bone displacement into root motion, and drop a clip into the Scene view to watch it loop.
